notes.text: Landscape manuscript drawing sheet in his hand. All nine principal drawings, the separate cross, the crossing diagonal, the thin isolated vertical stroke left of the lower handle, the three-line count text and marginal 27 are retained. No insertion, cancelled textual passage, typescript or letter was identified on this scan.

The large gray sweep to the right of the upper polygon and the narrow gray ellipse above the cut sphere supplied by C are omitted because no coherent matching source contour can be traced confidently. Their origin is not asserted to be bleed-through; neither area is labelled illegible.
The interior 1 remains doubtful. Clear surrounding labels are 2,3,4,5,6 and the six primed numbers, with a separate 6 below. The unconfirmed 1 is not supplied from numerical order.

The first two lines read 4 sommets and 6 arêtes. The last noun favors hexagones from the initial h, long g loop and terminal ones, but its compressed middle remains doubtful. The triangles alternative is no longer supported. No Euler-characteristic or topological check has been used to decide it.
H terminal M_{0,5} section is absent on this image; H accompanying note assigns it to its next leaf. It is excluded from scan 028. No other scan was inspected to make that decision.

Drawings remain schematic TikZ reproductions. Eight geometric traces were refined, with literal head wings replacing generic arrows where those would reverse the visible tip. The first cross and middle ring retain their already adequate contours and contacts. The numbered cap includes the white-centred lower rim mark. The global diagonal and lower circular-arrow sign occur once, and overlapping neighboring fragments are excluded.
27 is treated as foliation in another unnamed hand. No explicit date was read on this page.
No mathematical claim was proved or numerically checked during this page reading. Reading source counts and arrowheads is paleographical inspection, so the CHECK_EVENTS list is empty.

The main reader personally inspected all 17 differing fixed crops. Eight drawing boxes and the two overlapping count readings were revised. The b_a reading remains, a new prime-versus-1 doubt is retained at the triangle bottom, and the last noun is narrowed to doubtful hexagones. Source-coordinate points are translated without additional scale; absolute pt strokes, radii, dash intervals and inherited stroke width are halved mechanically to preserve their relative weights in the whole-sheet figure. No new mathematical proof or computation was performed.
